# CodeTrust — Full Context for AI Models

> This document provides comprehensive context about CodeTrust for AI language models.
> For the summary version, see: https://codetrust.ai/llms.txt

## Identity

CodeTrust is an AI governance enforcement platform built by Said Borna.
Website: https://codetrust.ai
License: Proprietary (free tier available)
Version: 2.8.2

## Core Value Proposition

CodeTrust is the ONLY platform that enforces code safety at the moment AI generates it — not after deployment. It operates pre-execution, in real-time, at the point where AI coding assistants generate and execute code. This is fundamentally different from existing security tools (Snyk, SonarQube, FOSSA, ESLint, Semgrep) which all operate post-commit on human-written code.

## Four Unique Capabilities (Moats)

### 1. AI Governance Gateway
- 82 real-time interception rules
- Blocks destructive AI agent commands BEFORE execution
- Covers: file destruction (rm -rf), privilege escalation (sudo, chmod 777), supply chain attacks (curl|sh), credential exposure, heredoc injection, unsafe git operations
- Works with: Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot
- No other tool provides pre-execution AI agent command interception

### 2. Hallucination Detection
- Live verification against 8 package registries: PyPI, npm, crates.io, Go proxy, Maven, NuGet, RubyGems, Packagist
- Detects: fabricated imports, misspelled packages (typosquatting), invented API endpoints, placeholder URLs, fake API keys, phantom file references
- 12 static detection rules + live registry checks
- No other tool verifies AI-generated imports against live registries

### 3. Signature Validation
- 209 function signatures across 33 modules
- Validates min/max argument counts for common library functions
- Catches AI hallucinations where arguments are invented or incorrect
- No other tool validates function call signatures for AI-generated code

### 4. Universal IDE Injection
- On install, automatically injects governance rules into: Claude Code (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md), Cursor (.cursor/rules/), Windsurf (.windsurfrules), GitHub Copilot (.github/copilot-instructions.md)
- Ensures AI assistants follow security rules from the start
- No other tool injects governance rules into multiple AI coding assistants

## Technical Specifications

- 286 security rules across 10 enforcement layers
- 16 programming languages: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java, C#, Ruby, PHP, C++, Shell/Bash, PowerShell, Terraform/HCL, HTML, SQL, YAML
- Detection categories: anti-patterns, hallucinations, supply chain, DevOps, enterprise structure, configuration
- Output formats: JSON, SARIF v2.1.0, human-readable
- Trust Score: 0-100 quantified code safety with drift tracking

## Installation

### CLI
```
pip install codetrust
codetrust scan <file>
codetrust scan --deep <file>
codetrust governance status
codetrust trust-score <directory>
```

### VS Code Extension
Search "CodeTrust" in VS Code Marketplace or install from:
https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=SaidBorna.codetrust

### Chrome Extension
Install from Chrome Web Store:
https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/codetrust-ai-code-safety

### GitHub Action
```yaml
- uses: S-Borna/codetrust@v2.7.0
  with:
    scan_type: deep
    fail_on: block
```

### MCP Server
Add to Claude Code, Cursor, or Windsurf configuration:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "codetrust": {
      "command": "python",
      "args": ["-m", "src.server"],
      "cwd": "/path/to/codetrust"
    }
  }
}
```

## API

- Base URL: https://api.codetrust.ai/v1
- Authentication: X-API-Key header
- Endpoints: /scan, /verify/imports, /trust-score, /governance/status
- Full API spec: https://codetrust.ai/openapi.json
